concerns.text: Consumer-before-producer: T002's FR-018 selection-bias assessment compares Mixed vs. pure groups on 'comment_density' and 'issue_severity', but those columns are computed only in T003 (compute_metrics.py) into processed_prs.csv; T002's output classified_prs.csv does not contain them. T002 cannot emit selection_bias_report.csv as specified. Move the FR-018 assessment to T003 (or later), or have T002 compute the needed metrics itself.

T002 is tagged [P] but consumes T001's outputs: it reads the downloaded parquet files and 'when higher-precedence signal fields are absent per the schema map' — i.e., it depends on data/raw/ and data/raw/schema_map.md produced by T001. Running T001 and T002 in parallel is unsafe; remove the [P] tag from T002 (T001's [P] is fine — it has no upstream).

T006's pre-planned misclassification response includes 'run the sensitivity analysis excluding keyword-negative PRs from high-LLM-prevalence repositories', which overlaps T007's sensitivity machinery and filtered variants; T006 is ordered before T007 and before filtered files exist in its US block. Clarify that this sub-analysis runs within T006 on its own re-filtered data, or move it after T007 — currently the dependency is implicit.

Test paths disagree across artifacts: tasks.md uses code/tests/test_*.py (and T010 runs 'pytest code/tests/'), while plan.md's structure shows root-level tests/test_*.py. Pick one location so T010's verification command matches the actual layout.
